theme: 个股·一致预期与业绩预告：紫金矿业业绩预告与一致预期盈利预测

initial.question: 紫金矿业最近一次业绩预告是什么类型？针对哪个报告期？
initial.gold_display: 最近一次业绩预告为“业绩大幅上升”（临时公告），针对2026年半年报（报告期截至2026-06-30），公告日2026-07-10
initial.gold_sql: SELECT A_STOCKSNAME,FORE_CLS,ENDDATE,DECLAREDATE,SRC FROM STK_ACHIEVE_FORECAST WHERE A_STOCKCODE='601899' AND ISVALID=1 ORDER BY DECLAREDATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 这次预告预计2026年上半年归母净利润大概多少钱？
feedbacks.gold_display: 预计2026年1-6月归母净利润3910000万元（约391亿元），预告上限与下限一致，同比增幅约68%
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT MAX_VAL,MIN_VAL FROM STK_ACHIEVE_FORECAST WHERE A_STOCKCODE='601899' AND ENDDATE='2026-06-30' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 去年同期那次预告呢？当时预计2025年上半年能赚多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 2025-07-14的预告为“业绩大幅上升”，预计2025年1-6月归母净利润2320000万元（约232亿元），同比增加约54%
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT MAX_VAL,MIN_VAL,FORE_CLS FROM STK_ACHIEVE_FORECAST WHERE A_STOCKCODE='601899' AND ENDDATE='2025-06-30' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 预告之外，再看看机构预测这边：紫金矿业2024年的一致预期净利润是多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 一致预期净利润约3196059.84万元（约319.61亿元），取最新数据日2025-06-13的一致预期值
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT CONSENSUS_PROFIT FROM VIEW_STK_CONSENSUS_FORECAST WHERE COMB_SYMBOL='601899.SH' AND FORECAST_YEAR=2024 AND ISVALID=1 AND END_DATE=(SELECT MAX(END_DATE) FROM VIEW_STK_CONSENSUS_FORECAST WHERE COMB_SYMBOL='601899.SH' AND FORECAST_YEAR=2024 AND ISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 对应的一致预期EPS和市盈率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 一致预期EPS约1.20元/股，对应一致预期PE约15.86倍（数据日2025-06-13）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT CONSENSUS_EPS,CONSENSUS_PE,END_DATE FROM VIEW_STK_CONSENSUS_FORECAST WHERE COMB_SYMBOL='601899.SH' AND FORECAST_YEAR=2024 AND ISVALID=1 ORDER BY END_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 另外帮我查一下，2026年半年报业绩预告里预计净利润上限最高的前五家公司是哪些？
feedbacks.gold_display: 中国人寿（上限1371.19亿元）、紫金矿业（391亿元）、中国神华（298亿元）、工业富联（244亿元）、新华保险（236.78亿元）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT A_STOCKSNAME,MAX(MAX_VAL) AS mv FROM STK_ACHIEVE_FORECAST WHERE ENDDATE='2026-06-30' AND ISVALID=1 GROUP BY A_STOCKCODE,A_STOCKSNAME ORDER BY mv DESC LIMIT 5
